import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Clean Sleep Disorder column
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Extract systolic blood pressure
df['Systolic BP'] = df['Blood Pressure'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split('/')[0]))

# Set up the figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values()
colors1 = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars1 = ax1.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax1.bar_label(bars1, fmt='%.1f')

# Plot 2: Quality of Sleep vs Stress Level
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       c=df['Physical Activity Level'], cmap='coolwarm', 
                       s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Stress Level')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Physical Activity Level')

# Plot 3: BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors3 = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(bmi_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors3, 
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(bmi_counts))
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# Plot 4: Heart Rate vs Daily Steps
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder]
    ax4.scatter(subset['Daily Steps'], subset['Heart Rate'], 
                label=disorder, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax4.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax4.set_title('Heart Rate vs Daily Steps')
ax4.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')

# Plot 5: Sleep Disorder by BMI Category
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
disorder_bmi = pd.crosstab(df['BMI Category'], df['Sleep Disorder'])
disorder_bmi.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=sns.color_palette('Paired', len(disorder_bmi.columns)))
ax5.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder by BMI Category')
ax5.legend(title='Sleep Disorder')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 6: Key Metrics Summary
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
metrics = ['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate']
means = [df['Sleep Duration'].mean(), df['Quality of Sleep'].mean(), 
         df['Stress Level'].mean()/10*10, df['Heart Rate'].mean()/10]
colors6 = sns.color_palette('husl', len(metrics))
bars6 = ax6.bar(metrics, means, color=colors6, edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_ylabel('Value (normalized scale)')
ax6.set_title('Average Key Metrics')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar, val in zip(bars6, [df['Sleep Duration'].mean(), df['Quality of Sleep'].mean(), 
                            df['Stress Level'].mean(), df['Heart Rate'].mean()]):
    ax6.annotate(f'{val:.1f}', xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height()),
                 ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
